question: In which of the following cities has the memorial dedicated to the 2ⁿd World War been built by Japan?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Imphal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Japan gifted Manipur (Imphal) a museum of peace** built on the memories of one of the fiercest battles of the** Second World War.**
 
• Hiroshima Peace Monument is a monument park in the **middle of Hiroshima, Japan.**
 
• It is committed to the heritage of Hiroshima as the first city in the **world to suffer a nuclear attack at the end of World War II,** and to the remembrance of the bomb's direct and indirect victims.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World War II,** a conflict that involved virtually every part of the world throughout** the years 1939–45.**
 
• Over the next six years, the dispute would take** more lives and demolish more land and property all over the globe than any previous war.**
 
• The **Second World War** began as the three crucial expansionist** "Axis" powers—Fascist Italy, Nazi Germany, and Imperial Japan—wanted to conquer other countries and build empires. ​ **
